Monica (Product): quick check — we're greenlighting the ratecard change next week. want a short owner + blocker list for metering/billing/quotas/contracts. who can own end-to-end?
Alex (Eng): I can take implementation and rollout for the API surface. current blocker: metering schema v2 isn't merged, CR #452 stalled on naming.
Priya (Metering): taking schema v2. small rename request from the billing team. I'll post a diff by EOD and wire up compatibility for 2 weeks.
Ben (Billing): thanks Priya. need to confirm final metric names and quota floor behavior. contract teams require no silent price decreases — must be explicit. also we need reconciliation logs for historical billing for 30 days.
Sam (Legal): adding: existing enterprise SLAs require 30-day notice for any material pricing change. we need a communication plan and opt-out flow for customers with contract clauses.
Dave (Platform): rollout plan idea: canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 72h windows, with automatic rollback if 95th latency diff >5ms or cost/unit regression >3%. I can own canary infra. feature flag name suggestion: `ratecard_v2_rollout`.
Alex (Eng): callout: the PR touches routing + quota enforcement. suggested runtime fallback: if metering doesn't respond, serve with old ratecard and emit metric. code snippet for fallback check: ```if (!metering.ok()) { use(ratecard_v1); emit("ratecard.fallback", 1); }```
Priya (Metering): for metric names propose: `redwood.ratecard.applied`, `redwood.ratecard.fallback`, `redwood.quota.override`. Ben, will those map to your billing pipelines?
Ben (Billing): yes on `redwood.ratecard.applied` and `redwood.ratecard.fallback`. need the exact tag set: `plan_id`, `customer_tier`, `region`. also confirm exports to billing-recon topic.
Sam (Legal): please put the notice language draft in the release doc. I can review tomorrow morning. also confirm customers with legacy contracts get manual outreach.
Dave (Platform): deploy-bot scheduled a dry-run for canary infra tomorrow. deploy-bot: canary-dryrun scheduled at 1949994800.
deploy-bot: dry-run created for ratecard_v2_rollout (canary). logs -> https://deploys.internal/redwood/1949994800
Monica (Product): summary/owners: Alex = implementation + CR; Priya = metering schema + compatibility; Ben = billing mapping + recon; Dave = canary infra + feature flag; Sam = legal + notices. milestones: PRs in by EOD Wed, dry-run Thu, canary next Tue. reply here with any objections or add blockers. :thumbsup:
Alex (Eng): no objections — I'll ping reviewers and move CR forward.
Priya (Metering): will post diff in ~3h. tagging @Ben (Billing) in the PR for metric confirmation.
Ben (Billing): will validate tag set and ack in PR. thanks.
Sam (Legal): ack, will review notice draft tomorrow.
Monica (Product): perfect — I'll update the release tracker and set a calendar invite for the post-canary sync.
